transport_mode: inert: injected storage and API transport; native origin/network/media not tested
scope: Actual Studio HTML/JS/CSS, synthetic assets and HTTP API fixture. No model inference, owner-PC, art or licence evidence.

checks.expectation: Favorite preserves unsaved notes
Favorite writes only favorite, not review/notes
Escape offers discard consent; Stay preserves draft
Lineage navigation cannot discard edits without consent
Close button offers the same discard choice as Escape
Save keeps the current asset open for continuation
Save failure is visible inside the open dialog
Duplicate save is disabled during in-flight mutation
Late save preserves newer typing and leaves it unsaved
Save persists its click-time snapshot exactly once
Late diagnostic success cannot replace the newly selected asset panel
Late diagnostic failure cannot attach retry to another asset
Current diagnostic failure retains explicit retry
390px dialog remains within viewport
720px dialog remains within viewport
These scenarios never create a generation or switch/install a backend
No JavaScript exceptions in complete shell
A→B→A rejects old diagnostic success
A→B→A rejects old diagnostic failure
Close/reopen rejects the previous session diagnostic
Favorite preserves title, tags and review together
Missing navigation target retains the active editor
Pending write holds close and navigation in the same session
Confirmed clean save can close normally
Favorite failure is visible, retains edits and releases controls
390px preview uses at most 35% viewport height
720px preview uses at most 35% viewport height
Dirty/save messages have a polite status region
Keyboard reaches Save from Notes and keeps the confirmed asset open
Trash error restores editing and retains the unsaved draft

remaining_confirmed_defect.scenario: Two clients edit from the same initial asset metadata
remaining_confirmed_defect.expected: Stale write conflicts rather than erasing A notes
remaining_confirmed_defect.observed: Both writes accepted; earlier notes overwritten
remaining_confirmed_defect.scope: Temporary real SQLite AssetWorkspace; no Studio construction, inference or user files

limitations: Native HTTP/browser origin and storage are pending actual CI evidence.
No model inference, Windows workstation, native editor, screen-reader or 200% zoom evidence.
Synthetic video placeholders do not establish media decoding.
Asset detail drafts are transient and do not survive browser reload.
